note: B3 per shot. A shot = one distinct firing moment and target among the smoker's shell, torpedo and airstrike events credited to its own smoke. Damage = every credited event (shells, fires, torpedoes) times its credited share. Per smoke = mean over smokes of each smoke's own-gun damage share. Positions from tracks at the firing moment (2 s samples, interpolated). Detection = the target's own track flag. Radar = the radar log lit spans.
